apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 172 (1.1.172) fixes Metal 4 activation with triple buffering: the effects renderer created three frame slots but rejected its resource set unless exactly two existed, causing fallback to Metal/Core Image with Metal 4 enabled. Both renderers now share the three-slot policy. HUD distinguishes requested Cloud G-Sync display pacing from actual renderer backend and reports Metal 4 fallback reasons. Includes the NVST Cloud G-Sync signaling and ProMotion display-range work from Build 171. Unsigned Release IPA for KravaSigner.
